scope:
Intrusive constrained DF endpoint and native allocation observation.

The 32-GiB numeric ledger is an observation ceiling, not the small-AO Python
inventory or a whole-process memory guarantee. The separately supplied DF
budget is enforced by the actual native value/response planners.

primed_ledger.scope: owned CUDA buffer capacities; excludes driver/graph/pool and library-internal allocations

components.interpretation: Host and GPU times overlap; do not add them. GPU intervals include stream idle time. Exclusive root residuals are unclassified runtime work. Capture counters describe construction only and exclude graph replay. Counter maxima are per operation, not the complete resource peak. Use unprofiled endpoints for performance claims.
